messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we've got repeating timeouts where streams cut mid-response. Want a short, actionable plan: server resume support, client backoff/resume, better metrics, and runbook updates. Can we split ownership?

sam: I'll take resume semantics on the server side. Plan: add a small resume token in stream footers and support `X-Stream-Resume: <token>` on reconnect. Prototype ideas: include last-emitted-offset + sequence checksum. ETA: spike by Wed.

eli: I'll do client heuristics and rollout. Proposal: 1) try resume if we detect a graceful EOF + token within 10s, 2) otherwise do jittered backoff and full restart. Add client-side telemetry header `X-Client-Stream-Reason` to correlate. PR target: Friday.

maria: Nice. What about partial responses that contain only metadata (empty text chunk) — those look like server-side flush race. Sam, can your spike include a test for that?

sam: yes — will add a unit test that forces metadata-only frames and validate resume token still points to last real content. Also instrument logs: `resume_token=%s stream_id=%s last_payload_size=%d`.

oncall-sre: I'll own the runbook update and short playbook: detection query, mitigation (increase keepalive, flip to resume-capable backend), rollback. ETA 2 business days. I'll also add a checklist to postmortem template so we don't miss ownership next time.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Scheduled nightly job to collect 24h sample of `stream_last_delta_ms` and `resume_token_missing` flags. Job: infra/stream-metrics-collector.

eli: Observability requests: add a histogram `stream_final_gap_ms` (p50/p95/p99) and a counter `resume_successful_total` vs `resume_failed_total`. Want alert if resume_failed_total / resume_attempts > 5% over 30m.

sam: Agree. Also adding tolerance in server: don't close connection for `socket_close` until we've emitted final chunk or set `resume_token=null`. That should reduce metadata-only partials.

maria: Can we pick canary region and rollout plan? Prefer starting with staging -> us-east-1 -> then cross-region. Also need acceptance criteria for closing the epic: sustained reduction in partials.

eli: Canary plan: staging 48h, us-east-1 72h, then global. Acceptance: partial_response_rate drop to <0.02% p95 over 7 days + resume_successful_total ratio > 98% during canary.

oncall-sre: For the runbook pager rules: page if partial_rate spike > 0.2% with p95 gap > 2s, or if resume_attempts fail rate > 10% for 15m. Otherwise log + slack channel notify.

maria: I'll create a daily 10m stand for the next week to unblock. Also add a single-source doc tracking owners, PRs, dashboards, and canary status.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-2024: "stream-resume-and-backoff-epic". Assignees: sam, eli, oncall-sre. Priority: P2.

eli: I'll open the Grafana dashboard PR tomorrow; temp link: https://grafana.company/d/stream/resume-health. Will include charts and an SLA impact panel.

sam: Spike notes (short): use resume token TTL = 60s, token entropy 128 bits, attach to final chunk as `resume_token`. Also instrument `resume_token_age_ms`.

oncall-sre: Runbook snippet I'm adding: 1) query: `sum(rate(stream_partial_total[5m])) by (region)`, 2) mitigation: flip proxy to resume-capable instance group, 3) postmortem steps. Will push in 48h.

maria: Great. Owners & soft deadlines: sam (spike + server PR by 2499050000), eli (client PR + dashboard by 2499060000), oncall-sre (runbook by 2499030000). Exit criteria: canary meets acceptance and infra job shows resume tokens present for >99% of resumed connections for 48h.

eli: small note: add correlation id header `X-Trace-Stream` on both sides to make debugging easier.

sam: ack. I'll include an example log line in the PR: `INFO resume_check stream_id=%s token=%s age_ms=%d resumed=%t`.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post calendar invites and update INF-2024 with links to PRs/dashboards. If anything blocks, shout here or @maria. :rocket:
